description: Listen for the person's next spoken reply to the open coach. While the person's Talk switch on the coach view is on, each time they stop speaking the view sends what they said to the coach, not into this chat. This waits up to wait_seconds for it and answers what they said (status heard, with the message number), or that they said nothing yet (status silent). Answer through coach_say with reply_to set to the message number, then call coach_listen again, for as long as they talk with the coach; stop when they type in the chat instead. Use the coach_id and coach.seat open_coach returned.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for the person to speak (the most when omitted; 0 only looks)

name: coach_listen

heard.description: from, message (its number, for coach_say's reply_to) and text: what the person said

title: Coach Listen
